series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: By 2020, 100 million consumers will shop in augmented reality.
entries.subject: Augmented reality shopping

entries.quote: By 2020, 30 percent of web browsing sessions will be done without a screen.
entries.subject: Screenless web browsing
entries.metric: share of web browsing sessions without a screen

entries.quote: By 2019, 20 percent of brands will abandon their mobile apps.
entries.subject: Brand mobile apps
entries.metric: share of brands abandoning mobile apps

entries.quote: By 2020, algorithms will positively alter the behavior of more than 1 billion global workers.
entries.subject: Algorithmic influence on workers
entries.metric: workers whose behavior is altered by algorithms

entries.quote: By 2022, a blockchain-based business will be worth $10 billion.
entries.subject: Blockchain business valuation

entries.quote: By 2021, 20 percent of all activities an individual engages in will involve at least one of the top-seven digital giants.
entries.subject: Digital giants in daily life
entries.metric: share of individual activities involving a top-seven digital giant

entries.quote: Through 2019, every $1 enterprises invest in innovation will require an additional $7 in core execution.
entries.subject: Innovation vs core execution cost
entries.metric: additional core execution spend per $1 of innovation

entries.quote: Through 2020, IoT will increase data center storage demand by less than 3 percent.
entries.subject: IoT data center storage demand
entries.metric: increase in data center storage demand from IoT

entries.quote: By 2022, IoT will save consumers and businesses $1 trillion a year in maintenance, services and consumables.
entries.subject: IoT savings
entries.metric: annual savings for consumers and businesses

entries.quote: By 2020, 40 percent of employees can cut their healthcare costs by wearing a fitness tracker.
entries.subject: Fitness trackers and healthcare costs
entries.metric: share of employees able to cut healthcare costs by wearing a fitness tracker
